entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-90210-PULSE. Just tell me what I need to do to send it back.

Got it, VF-90210-PULSE. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 12th. So we can process this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
No fault, I just don't want it. Can I return it or not?

Okay, thanks for clarifying. I see you're on day 12 since delivery. For our new VeloBand Pulse, we have a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns, mainly for hygiene reasons once the device has been activated. So, technically, this is just outside that period.

Listen, that's not going to work. The only reason it wasn't returned on time is because we had a serious family emergency. My wife was scheduled for a military deployment, but she ended up in the hospital and needed unexpected surgery. I've been there the entire time and haven't had a moment to deal with a return.

I'm so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful. I hope your wife's recovery is going well. Thank you for explaining the situation. That absolutely qualifies as an extenuating circumstance we can make an exception for.
So you can process the refund?

Yes, absolutely. Given the medical emergency and the circumstances around the deployment, I am overriding the policy and authorizing a one-time exception for a full refund. I'm sending you a prepaid return shipping label via email right now. Do you see it come through?
Checking... Yes, I just got the email. Okay, good. That's what I needed.
Perfect. Just use that label to send the device back, and your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days of us receiving it. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
You're very welcome. I wish your wife a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
